user.title: Connect your WiZ RGBIC strip
user.description: Connect directly to the strip without an ESP. Enter the installed block count: each block has 6 LEDs on supported hardware. Up to three initial segments will be created. Custom mode 258 must remain unused by saved WiZ app modes. Setup does not change lighting.

data.total_blocks: Number of physical blocks (6 LEDs each)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the strip. Check its IP address and local UDP access.
error.unsupported_device: This version supports the ESP25_MHORGB_01 module only.
error.wrong_device: This IP belongs to a different strip.
error.invalid_layout: Use non-overlapping ranges inside the strip, with at least one segment. Edit an existing range before adding a segment in its place.
error.too_many_steps: This layout exceeds 12 regions when dark gaps and the unused tail are included.

init.title: Configure your segments
init.description: Add, remove or resize segments. One block is 6 LEDs. Changes apply only after Save.

segment.title: Segment boundaries
segment.description: Enter the segment length in blocks. Auto-arrange packs segments from block 1 without gaps, retaining their current order; new segments are appended. First block is ignored in this mode. Otherwise, First block sets the position. Shrink other segments if there is insufficient space.

remove.title: Choose a segment to remove
remove.description: Removal is staged until Save. Lighting changes on your next light command.

device.title: Strip settings
device.description: If the strip was shortened, resize or remove ranges outside its new length before reducing the block count.

data.total_blocks: Number of physical blocks (6 LEDs each)

distribute.title: Distribute the strip into segments
distribute.description: Divide the whole strip evenly into the chosen count. Replaces existing sizes and gaps. Keeps names and IDs of the first segments; reducing the count removes the last ones. Review before Save.
